# WebDesign-ToolKit

A 100% human and AI-agent collaborative front-end architecture toolkit. This repository serves as pure documentation and an infrastructure guide to generate high-quality interfaces while strictly avoiding "AI slop" and respecting isolated brand guidelines.

## Repository Structure

* `/.agents/skills/`: Agent skills installed by the [skills CLI](https://skills.sh/). Each subdirectory contains a `SKILL.md` with a YAML header. Populated by `setup.sh` (git-ignored).
* `skills-lock.json`: Local lockfile generated by the skills CLI on install (git-ignored).
* `/BRANDS/`: Brand contexts (mostly git-ignored for IP isolation). Tracked scaffold: `BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/` (brand) and `BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/Projects/_TEMPLATE/` (project). Copy the template into `BRANDS/{brand}/` — do not use `_TEMPLATE` as a live brand.
* `/vendor/`: (Git-ignored) Cloned third-party checkouts and optional visual-testing package, provisioned by `setup.sh`.
* `/docs/`: Human guide ([`docs/GUIDE.md`](docs/GUIDE.md)), Architectural Decision Records ([`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)), and per-tool setup guides (`docs/tools/*/SETUP.md`). Index: [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md).
* `setup.sh`: The unified bash script to provision the environment and install curated tools/skills.
* `TOOLS.md`: (Git-ignored) Machine-local inventory of installed tools, binaries, and commands. Generated by `setup.sh`.
* `AGENTS.md`: The master guide and rulebook for LLM execution.

## Prerequisites

Install these before running `./setup.sh` (the script will also attempt to install `pnpm` and Poetry if missing).

### Required

| Requirement | Used by | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Git** | All clones / skills | Required to fetch Taste Skill, awesome-design-md, screenshot-to-code, etc. |
| **curl** | Poetry bootstrap, downloads | Required for installer scripts. |
| **Node.js 18+** and **npm** | Originkit, shadcn, skills CLI, screenshot-to-code frontend, optional visual testing | LTS recommended. |
| **pnpm** | screenshot-to-code frontend, Cult/Skiper workflows, optional visual testing | Installed automatically via corepack/npm if missing. |
| **Python 3.10+** | screenshot-to-code backend | Required for Poetry environment. |
| **Poetry** | screenshot-to-code backend | Installed automatically if missing. |
| **Disk / network** | Vendor clones under `/vendor/` and skills under `/.agents/skills/` | First run downloads multiple repositories and skill packages. |

### Tool-specific credentials (as needed)

| Credential | Tool | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ORIGINKIT_API_KEY` | Originkit | Required to fetch component source (10 free requests/day). Or run `originkit login`. |
| OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini API key | screenshot-to-code | At least one key in `vendor/screenshot-to-code/backend/.env`. |
| `SKIPER_LICENSE_KEY` | Skiper UI Pro | Optional; free components work without it (attribution required). |

### Optional — Midscene.js & Puppeteer

Visual testing is **optional**. `setup.sh` prompts whether to install it (or use `--with-visual-testing` / `--skip-visual-testing`).

| Requirement | Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Chromium browser binary** | Downloaded by Puppeteer into the local cache. |
| **`MIDSCENE_MODEL_API_KEY`** (+ related `MIDSCENE_MODEL_*` vars) | Required to run Midscene vision agents. See `docs/tools/midscene-js/SETUP.md`. |
| **Extra disk space** | Browser binary + `vendor/visual-testing/` node_modules. |

### Project-level (when generating UI)

Cult UI and Skiper UI expect a **React + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui** app under `/BRANDS/{brand}/Projects/{project_name}/`. Those project deps are not installed at toolkit root.

## Quick start

```bash
./setup.sh
# optional visual testing:
./setup.sh --with-visual-testing
```

After setup, read `TOOLS.md` for installed binaries and paths. Per-tool details live in `docs/tools/*/SETUP.md`.

**New here?** Start with the human guide: [`docs/GUIDE.md`](docs/GUIDE.md).

## Brand & project templates

Real brand IP under `/BRANDS/{brand}/` stays git-ignored. The versioned scaffold lives at `BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/`:

```bash
# New brand
mkdir -p BRANDS/acme && cp -a BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/. BRANDS/acme/
rm -rf BRANDS/acme/Projects/_TEMPLATE   # until you add a project

# New project under that brand
mkdir -p BRANDS/acme/Projects/marketing-site
cp -a BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/Projects/_TEMPLATE/. BRANDS/acme/Projects/marketing-site/
```

| Template | Becomes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/` | `/BRANDS/{brand}/` — `README.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `brandbook.md`, `history/`, `Projects/` |
| `BRANDS/_TEMPLATE/Projects/_TEMPLATE/` | `/BRANDS/{brand}/Projects/{project_name}/` — `README.md`, optional `DESIGN.md`, `history/` |

Each template Markdown file documents **what that file is for**. Replace the descriptions with real brand/project content after copying. Full instructions: [`BRANDS/README.md`](BRANDS/README.md).

Guideline precedence remains: **Project > Brand > Vercel**.

## Curated Tools & Skills

| Tool / Skill | Link | License & Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Taste Skill** | [tasteskill.dev](https://www.tasteskill.dev/) | MIT License. Open source constraint guidelines to enforce design quality. |
| **BrandBooker** | [zvorky/brandbooker](https://github.com/zvorky/brandbooker) | Brand system skill set. Use on request only; run `brandbook-review` whenever a brand is added or updated. |
| **awesome-design-md** | [VoltAgent/awesome-design-md](https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md) | Open source reference for plain-text design constraints and brand systems. |
| **Originkit** | [originkit.dev](https://www.originkit.dev/) | Open source. Free components; MCP server requires an API key (10 free requests/day). |
| **Cult UI** | [cult-ui.com](https://www.cult-ui.com/) | MIT License. Free for commercial/personal use, no attribution required. |
| **Skiper UI** | [skiper-ui.com](https://skiper-ui.com/) | Hybrid. Free base components require attribution; Pro version is attribution-free. |
| **screenshot-to-code** | [topics/image-to-code](https://github.com/topics/image-to-code) | MIT License. Open source and free for local hosting. |
| **Vercel Guidelines** | [vercel.com/design/guidelines](https://vercel.com/design/guidelines) | Optional fallback reference for brands without their own style guides. |
| **Midscene.js** *(optional)* | [midscenejs.com](https://midscenejs.com/) | MIT License. Vision-driven UI automation for autonomous visual testing. |
| **Puppeteer** *(optional)* | [pptr.dev](https://pptr.dev/) | Apache-2.0. Headless browser automation; recommended baseline alongside Midscene.js. |
